description: BMKG Online Data (Data Online) is a data repository run by Agency for Meteorology, Climatology and Geophysics (BMKG), Indonesia. The service sells or gives climate, weather and geophysical observations of BMKG stations for research on request, with catalogue search by station and element. Coverage: Indonesia. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, excel; access needs registration, and some data are chargeable for non-research use. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Data Online - Direktorat Data dan Komputasi BMKG") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support weather and hazard inputs for Indonesian infrastructure studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
